Oktoberfest in Des Moines 2023: Ultimate Guide to Beer Gardens & German Festivals

Prost! Des Moines is embracing its German heritage this fall with an incredible lineup of Oktoberfest celebrations across the metro. From traditional beer gardens in the East Village to festive events in Valley Junction, here's your complete guide to experiencing authentic German culture right here in Central Iowa.

Main Oktoberfest Celebrations in Des Moines

Hessen Haus Oktoberfest (Court Avenue)

The epicenter of Des Moines' German festivities, Hessen Haus transforms Court Avenue into a slice of Munich from September 22-24, 2023. Featuring:

  • Traditional German beer hall atmosphere
  • Live polka bands and accordion players
  • Authentic German food including schnitzel, bratwurst, and pretzels
  • Over 40 German beer varieties
  • Stein-holding competitions

High Life Lounge Bavarian Bash (Downtown)

Located near Principal Park, this retro-style venue hosts its annual celebration September 30, offering a uniquely Iowa twist on German traditions with local craft beers alongside traditional imports.

Beer Gardens & German Venues

Des Moines boasts several year-round German-inspired destinations:

  • Confluence Brewing Company (Gray's Lake area)
  • 515 Brewing Company (Clive)
  • Exile Brewing Company (Western Gateway)
  • Peace Tree Brewing (East Village)

Traditional German Food Spots

Restaurants & Delis

Sample authentic German cuisine at these local favorites:

  • B&B Grocery, Meat & Deli (South Side)
  • Gateway Market (Woodland Heights)
  • European Flavors (Urbandale)

Family-Friendly Oktoberfest Activities

Several venues offer kid-friendly celebrations:

  • Valley Junction Family Fest (September 23)
  • Living History Farms German Heritage Day (October 1)
  • Jasper Winery's Harvest Festival (September 30)

Local Tips & Planning Your Visit

Make the most of your Des Moines Oktoberfest experience:

  • Book rideshare services in advance during peak festival times
  • Many venues offer hotel packages with local partners like Des Lux Hotel and Surety Hotel
  • Purchase tickets early - events often sell out
  • Check DART routes for convenient public transportation options
